items.title: Resume at a glance
items.text: The Play button says what it plays and how much is left, with a ring showing how far you got.

items.title: Source health
items.text: A coloured mark on each stream: smooth, may buffer or slow. Turn it on in Settings > Playback.

items.title: Playback info
items.text: Press the blue key while a film plays: the source, the file, its bitrate and a live graph of the buffer.
